note: Captured via a temporary SQS dead-letter queue attached to the failing EventBridge target - EventBridge does not otherwise surface a delivery failure reason. Account ID masked.
symptom: aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/Events --metric-name FailedInvocations --dimensions Name=RuleName,Value=security-posture-security-hub-findings returned Sum=1 for every real invocation; CloudWatch Logs describe-log-streams on the target log group always returned 0 streams.

dlq_message_attributes.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not complete putLogEvents call for /observability/security-posture/security-hub-findings.

ruled_out: KMS: reproduced with the log group's KMS key disassociated entirely - same failure
Resource-policy propagation delay: reproduced on a brand-new, isolated log group/rule/policy triplet, retried after a 3-minute wait - same failure
Service control policies: no custom SCP attached to this account or its OU (only AWS-managed FullAWSAccess)
root_cause: The resource policy's Resource field was the bare log group ARN (arn:...:log-group:/path/to/group). CloudWatch Logs authorizes PutLogEvents/CreateLogStream against the log *stream* resource, which doesn't exist until the first successful delivery - so a bare log-group ARN never matches, and every delivery fails, silently, forever, on every dashboard that copies this pattern.
fix: Append ':*' to the Resource ARN (arn:...:log-group:/path/to/group:*). Verified: after the fix, an isolated triplet with the identical policy shape immediately received the next event (0 -> 1 log streams).

confirmed_working_after_fix.log_delivery: 1 log stream, event content matches the finding submitted via BatchImportFindings
confirmed_working_after_fix.metric_filter: SecurityHubCriticalFindings metric: 1 real CloudWatch datapoint, Sum=1.0, from a Severity.Label=CRITICAL synthetic finding
